title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: Miller soundboard captures a high‑energy 1982 show that SMOKES, highlighted by a wild Throwing Stones > Day Job pairing and fiery renditions of Shakedown Street and Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as an “awesome” Miller soundboard capture with crystal‑clear mix, while fans rave about the show’s nonstop energy – especially the scorching Throwing Stones into Day Job segue and the monster performances of Shakedown Street and Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain. One reviewer gave a zero rating, calling the song pairing unexpected, which tempers the overall enthusiasm.

ai_rating.rationale: Two highly positive 5‑star reviews highlight both stellar performance and excellent soundboard quality; a single 0‑star review introduces doubt, resulting in a strong but not perfect overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the audio as “awesome” and a Miller gem; no dropouts or mix issues reported.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual but exciting song pairing (Throwing Stones into Day Job) noted; overall set flows with high‑energy jams and tight transitions.
